name: Lenalidomide Maintenance (post-autologous transplant)

biomarkers.note: Lenalidomide maintenance is not biomarker-restricted; it improves PFS across risk groups after autologous HCT. In high-risk cytogenetics a PFS (but not clearly OS) benefit was seen, and two-drug maintenance (e.g. adding a proteasome inhibitor) is often favored for high-risk disease. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Multiple Myeloma, v5.2026.

lineOfTherapy: maintenance therapy after autologous hematopoietic cell transplant (or after primary therapy) in multiple myeloma; Preferred, category 1

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: response to induction and (typically) autologous HCT; standard-risk disease is the classic single-agent lenalidomide maintenance population
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v5.2026, MYEL-G (Maintenance Therapy): Lenalidomide, Preferred, category 1

drugs.name: Lenalidomide

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 74 (Plasma Cell Neoplasms), myeloma regimen/trials table (lines 26314, 26347) (Maintenance lenalidomide 15 mg PO days 1-21 every 4 wks)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., myeloma maintenance entry (lines 26314 and 26347): maintenance lenalidomide 15 mg PO on days 1 to 21 every 4 weeks (28-day cycle), continued until progression or unacceptable toxicity. A lower starting dose of 10 mg daily is commonly used in practice and titrated to tolerance, but the concretely printed maintenance dose in the provided source is 15 mg; the 10 mg value is noted for clinical context and is not asserted from a myeloma-specific source locator here. Requires VTE thromboprophylaxis and REMS-program dispensing (teratogen).

supportiveCare: Lenalidomide: VTE thromboprophylaxis (aspirin for standard risk) and REMS-program dispensing (teratogen); adjust for renal impairment.
Counsel on and monitor for second primary malignancy (increased risk reported with lenalidomide maintenance).
Monitor for cumulative cytopenias with prolonged maintenance.

monitoring: CBC with differential and platelets periodically (cumulative myelosuppression risk)
myeloma response markers (SPEP/serum free light chains) per follow-up schedule

doseModificationRules.text: Hold and resume lenalidomide at a reduced maintenance dose per labeling for grade 3 to 4 cytopenia; clinical review.

guideline.locator: MYEL-G (Maintenance Therapy): Lenalidomide, Preferred, category 1; footnote noting increased risk of secondary cancers with lenalidomide maintenance

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent lenalidomide maintenance after autologous HCT in multiple myeloma (#82). The maintenance dose is sourced to DeVita 12th ed. (myeloma maintenance entry, lines 26314 and 26347): lenalidomide 15 mg PO days 1 to 21 every 4 weeks (28-day cycle), continued until progression. A lower 10 mg daily starting dose is common in practice and titrated to tolerance; the provided source concretely prints 15 mg, so the modeled dose is 15 mg and the 10 mg value is recorded as clinical context only (not asserted from a myeloma-specific locator). Preferred, category 1 status is sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Multiple Myeloma v5.2026, MYEL-G (Maintenance Therapy), which also flags an increased risk of second primary malignancy with lenalidomide maintenance. Lenalidomide requires VTE prophylaxis and REMS. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
